decisions.title: Delete failed searches
decisions.detail: Failed searches are now kept in the Previous Searches panel, marked "Failed" with their error. Before, they were never saved.
decisions.todo: Failed searches now stay in the Previous Searches panel marked "Failed". Add a way to delete a search (failed or otherwise) from the panel.

decisions.title: Cancel a running search
decisions.detail: There is no way to stop a running search and no limit on how many run at once. Their Google lookups queue on the one shared browser.
decisions.todo: Add a Cancel button for a running search in the Previous Searches panel, and cap how many searches can run at the same time (extra ones wait or are refused with a clear message).

decisions.title: Job queue for background searches
decisions.detail: Background searches use in-memory threads, so they only work with a single server process. Moving to Supabase or several servers would need a real job queue.
decisions.todo: Move background searches off in-memory threads onto a persistent job queue so they survive restarts and work with more than one server process (plan alongside the Supabase migration).

decisions.title: Cancel from the results page
decisions.detail: A running search can only be cancelled from the Previous Searches panel. The results page you are watching has no Cancel control.
decisions.todo: Add a Cancel button to the search results page while a search is running, reusing POST /api/searches/{id}/cancel.

decisions.title: Queue searches over the cap
decisions.detail: When MAX_CONCURRENT_SEARCHES (default 2) searches are running, new ones are refused with a 429 message instead of waiting their turn.
decisions.todo: Instead of refusing searches over MAX_CONCURRENT_SEARCHES, save them as "queued", start them automatically when a slot frees up, and show them as Queued in the Previous Searches panel.

decisions.title: Clear all failed searches
decisions.detail: Searches can now be deleted one at a time, with a confirm step. There is no bulk action to clear every failed search at once.
decisions.todo: Add a "Clear failed" action to the Previous Searches panel that deletes every failed search after one confirmation, reusing DELETE /api/searches/{id} or a new bulk endpoint.
